items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: I played there with Adolphe Ducanger, Albert Ducanger, and Pete Ducanger.

ctx.x: With Sidney Desvines Orchestra. Can you tell us how you started in music? Your first instrument, what it was? Did you start on drums or something else? On drums. On drums. On drums. I've taken lessons with Professor Cantrell. Oh, yes. Old man, Lloyd Cantrell, was playing drums with Peter Ones Orchestra. Can you remember how you got your first set of drums, what they were like? Oh, yeah. My first job I had was over at Tom Anderson's Cabaret. I played there with Adolphe Ducanger, Albert Ducanger, and Pete Ducanger.
